title: Amputation
summary: Control the bleeding first – use a tourniquet if needed. Then save the amputated part: wrap it, bag it and keep it cool but not frozen.

callEmergency.headline: Call {EMERGENCY} for any amputation
when: Any amputated finger, toe or limb
Severe bleeding or signs of shock

steps.title: Control the bleeding
steps.text: Firm direct pressure. For an arm or leg with life-threatening bleeding, apply a tourniquet.

steps.title: Save the amputated part
steps.text: Wrap it in clean, moist gauze or cloth. Put it in a sealed plastic bag. Put the bag in a container of ice and water.
steps.caution: The part must not touch ice directly and must not freeze.

steps.title: Label it
steps.text: Write the person's name and the time of the injury on the bag and send it with the person.

doNot: Do not put the amputated part directly on ice or in water
Do not wash the part with anything other than clean water if it is dirty
Do not delay bleeding control to look for the part
